+defmodule ResidencyScheduleWeb.RotationSupportLiveTest do
+  use ResidencyScheduleWeb.ConnCase

+

+  alias ResidencySchedule.RotationSupportFixtures, as: Fixtures
+  alias ResidencySchedule.Residents
+
+  setup :admin_authenticate_session
+
+  test "editor shows schedule abbreviations and offers every supported rotation", %{conn: conn} do
+    assert {:ok, result, []} =
+             ScheduleImporter.import_csv(Fixtures.csv(Enum.map(Fixtures.pairs(), &elem(&1, 0))))
+
+    [resident] = Residents.list_residents_for_schedule(result.schedule_id)
+
+    rotations =
+      Residents.get_resident!(resident.id).rotations |> Enum.sort_by(& &1.start_date, Date)
+
+    {:ok, view, _} = live(conn, "/admin/edit")
+
+    view
+    |> form("form[phx-submit='load_schedule']", %{"schedule_id" => to_string(result.schedule_id)})
+    |> render_submit()
+
+    for {{label, _}, rotation} <- Enum.zip(Fixtures.pairs(), rotations) do
+      assert has_element?(
+               view,
+               "#editor-grid [data-rotation-id='#{rotation.id}'] button[phx-click='edit_assignment']",
+               label
+             )
+    end
+
+    view
+    |> element("[phx-click='edit_assignment'][phx-value-id='#{hd(rotations).id}']")
+    |> render_click()
+
+    for {_, type} <- Fixtures.pairs() do
+      assert has_element?(view, "#assignment-form select option[value='#{type}']")
+    end
+
+    refute has_element?(view, "#assignment-form select option[value='scn']")
+  end

+
+    assert has_element?(
+             view,
+             "#sticky-stats div[title^='Total scheduled service blocks'] p.text-xl",
+             "1"
+           )
+  end
+end

+defmodule ResidencySchedule.RotationSupportIntegrationTest do
+  use ResidencySchedule.DataCase
+
+  alias ResidencySchedule.Importer.ScheduleImporter
+  alias ResidencySchedule.{Residents, ScheduleBuilder, ScheduleEditor}
+  alias ResidencySchedule.RotationSupportFixtures, as: Fixtures
+
+  test "all new rotations persist through import, builder save and explicit date updates" do
+    pairs = Fixtures.pairs()
+    csv = Fixtures.csv(Enum.map(pairs, &elem(&1, 0)))
+    assert {:ok, result, []} = ScheduleImporter.import_csv(csv)
+    expected = Enum.map(pairs, &Atom.to_string(elem(&1, 1)))
+
+    expected_assignments =
+      Enum.with_index(expected, fn type, index ->
+        date = Date.add(~D[2026-07-06], index)
+        {type, date, date}
+      end)
+
+    assert types(result.schedule_id) == expected
+    assert assignments(result.schedule_id) == expected_assignments
+    assert {:ok, state} = ScheduleBuilder.load_from_schedule(result.schedule_id)
+    assert {:ok, _} = ScheduleBuilder.save(state)
+    assert types(result.schedule_id) == expected
+    assert assignments(result.schedule_id) == expected_assignments
+
+    assert {:ok, _, []} =
+             ScheduleImporter.import_csv(csv, mode: :update_dates, academic_year: 2026)
+
+    assert types(result.schedule_id) == expected
+    assert assignments(result.schedule_id) == expected_assignments
+  end
+
+  test "builder save preserves noncanonical ordinary-import dates for existing clinical rotations" do
+    csv =
+      ",Dates,2026-07-08,2026-07-14\n,,2026-07-09,2026-07-16\n,,Events\nR4-1,Test Resident,OB,GYN\n"
+
+    assert {:ok, result, []} = ScheduleImporter.import_csv(csv)
+
+    expected = [
+      {"strong_obstetrics", ~D[2026-07-08], ~D[2026-07-09]},
+      {"strong_gynecology", ~D[2026-07-14], ~D[2026-07-16]}
+    ]
+
+    assert assignments(result.schedule_id) == expected
+    assert {:ok, state} = ScheduleBuilder.load_from_schedule(result.schedule_id)
+    assert {:ok, _} = ScheduleBuilder.save(state)
+    assert assignments(result.schedule_id) == expected
+  end
+
+  test "canonical Highland adjusted bounds retain the annual builder calendar and shift dates" do
+    csv =
+      ",Dates,2026-06-29,2026-07-04\n,,2026-07-03,2026-07-05\n,,Events\nR4-1,Test Resident,HNF,HWN\n"
+
+    assert {:ok, result, []} = ScheduleImporter.import_csv(csv)
+
+    expected = [
+      {"highland_night_float", ~D[2026-06-28], ~D[2026-07-03]},
+      {"highland_weekend_nights", ~D[2026-07-04], ~D[2026-07-04]}
+    ]
+
+    assert assignments(result.schedule_id) == expected
+    assert {:ok, state} = ScheduleBuilder.load_from_schedule(result.schedule_id)
+    assert length(state.slots) == 100
+    assert {:ok, _} = ScheduleBuilder.save(state)
+    assert assignments(result.schedule_id) == expected
+  end
+
+  test "ordinary daily clinic overlapping adjusted HNF refuses unsafe annual-calendar fallback" do
+    csv =
+      ",Dates,2026-07-06,2026-07-07\n,,2026-07-06,2026-07-07\n,,Events\nR4-1,Test Resident,MFM,HNF\n"
+
+    assert {:ok, result, []} = ScheduleImporter.import_csv(csv)
+
+    expected = [
+      {"mfm", ~D[2026-07-06], ~D[2026-07-06]},
+      {"highland_night_float", ~D[2026-07-06], ~D[2026-07-07]}
+    ]
+
+    assert assignments(result.schedule_id) == expected
+    assert {:error, reason} = ScheduleBuilder.load_from_schedule(result.schedule_id)
+    assert String.downcase(reason) =~ "overlap"

+    resident.id

+  defp assignments(id) do

+end

+  end
+
+  test "leave of absence is non-working; admin, clinics and orientation are working solo assignments" do

+defmodule ResidencySchedule.RotationSupportIntegrationTest do
+  use ResidencySchedule.DataCase
+
+  alias ResidencySchedule.Importer.ScheduleImporter
+  alias ResidencySchedule.{Residents, ScheduleBuilder, ScheduleEditor}
+  alias ResidencySchedule.RotationSupportFixtures, as: Fixtures
+
+  test "all new rotations persist through import, builder save and explicit date updates" do
+    pairs = Fixtures.pairs()
+    csv = Fixtures.csv(Enum.map(pairs, &elem(&1, 0)))
+    assert {:ok, result, []} = ScheduleImporter.import_csv(csv)
+    expected = Enum.map(pairs, &Atom.to_string(elem(&1, 1)))
+
+    expected_assignments =
+      Enum.with_index(expected, fn type, index ->
+        date = Date.add(~D[2026-07-06], index)
+        {type, date, date}
+      end)
+
+    assert types(result.schedule_id) == expected
+    assert assignments(result.schedule_id) == expected_assignments
+    assert {:ok, state} = ScheduleBuilder.load_from_schedule(result.schedule_id)
+    assert {:ok, _} = ScheduleBuilder.save(state)
+    assert types(result.schedule_id) == expected
+    assert assignments(result.schedule_id) == expected_assignments
+
+    assert {:ok, _, []} =
+             ScheduleImporter.import_csv(csv, mode: :update_dates, academic_year: 2026)
+
+    assert types(result.schedule_id) == expected
+    assert assignments(result.schedule_id) == expected_assignments
+  end
+
+  test "builder save preserves noncanonical ordinary-import dates for existing clinical rotations" do
+    csv =
+      ",Dates,2026-07-08,2026-07-14\n,,2026-07-09,2026-07-16\n,,Events\nR4-1,Test Resident,OB,GYN\n"
+
+    assert {:ok, result, []} = ScheduleImporter.import_csv(csv)
+
+    expected = [
+      {"strong_obstetrics", ~D[2026-07-08], ~D[2026-07-09]},
+      {"strong_gynecology", ~D[2026-07-14], ~D[2026-07-16]}
+    ]
+
+    assert assignments(result.schedule_id) == expected
+    assert {:ok, state} = ScheduleBuilder.load_from_schedule(result.schedule_id)
+    assert {:ok, _} = ScheduleBuilder.save(state)
+    assert assignments(result.schedule_id) == expected
+  end
+
+  test "canonical Highland adjusted bounds retain the annual builder calendar and shift dates" do
+    csv =
+      ",Dates,2026-06-29,2026-07-04\n,,2026-07-03,2026-07-05\n,,Events\nR4-1,Test Resident,HNF,HWN\n"
+
+    assert {:ok, result, []} = ScheduleImporter.import_csv(csv)
+
+    expected = [
+      {"highland_night_float", ~D[2026-06-28], ~D[2026-07-03]},
+      {"highland_weekend_nights", ~D[2026-07-04], ~D[2026-07-04]}
+    ]
+
+    assert assignments(result.schedule_id) == expected
+    assert {:ok, state} = ScheduleBuilder.load_from_schedule(result.schedule_id)
+    assert length(state.slots) == 100
+    assert {:ok, _} = ScheduleBuilder.save(state)
+    assert assignments(result.schedule_id) == expected
+  end
+
+  test "ordinary daily clinic overlapping adjusted HNF refuses unsafe annual-calendar fallback" do
+    csv =
+      ",Dates,2026-07-06,2026-07-07\n,,2026-07-06,2026-07-07\n,,Events\nR4-1,Test Resident,MFM,HNF\n"
+
+    assert {:ok, result, []} = ScheduleImporter.import_csv(csv)
+
+    expected = [
+      {"mfm", ~D[2026-07-06], ~D[2026-07-06]},
+      {"highland_night_float", ~D[2026-07-06], ~D[2026-07-07]}
+    ]
+
+    assert assignments(result.schedule_id) == expected
+    assert {:error, reason} = ScheduleBuilder.load_from_schedule(result.schedule_id)
+    assert String.downcase(reason) =~ "overlap"

+    resident.id

+  defp assignments(id) do

+end

+  end
+
+  test "leave of absence is non-working; admin, clinics and orientation are working solo assignments" do

  end

+    render_upload(file, "detail.xlsx")

  end

    :ok = :telemetry.attach(handler, [:residency_schedule, :repo, :query], fn _, _, metadata, _ ->

  end

+defmodule ResidencySchedule.ActivitySuggestionsTest do
+  use ResidencySchedule.DataCase
+  import ResidencySchedule.ActivitySearchFixtures
+  alias ResidencySchedule.{DetailedSchedules, Residents, Schedules}
+  alias ResidencySchedule.DetailedSchedules.Activity
+
+  setup do
+    seed_activity_search()
+  end
+
+  test "suggestions are distinct literal task labels, excluding notes and names" do
+    assert {:ok, labels} = suggestions(%{query: "CLINIC"})
+    assert labels == ["GOG Continuity Clinic AM", "GOG Continuity Clinic PM"]
+    assert {:ok, []} = suggestions(%{query: "simulation"})
+    assert {:ok, []} = suggestions(%{query: "Iris Reed"})
+    assert {:ok, []} = suggestions(%{query: "Page 1"})
+  end
+
+  test "percent, underscore and backslash are literal substrings", ctx do
+    insert_labels(ctx.iris.id, [
+      "Literal 100% Clinic",
+      "Literal clinic_A",
+      "Literal C:\\Room",
+      "Literal clinicXA"
+    ])
+
+    assert {:ok, ["Literal 100% Clinic"]} = suggestions(%{query: "%"})
+    assert {:ok, ["Literal clinic_A"]} = suggestions(%{query: "_"})
+    assert {:ok, ["Literal C:\\Room"]} = suggestions(%{query: "\\"})
+  end
+
+  test "labels respect selected academic year, stable person and inclusive dates", ctx do
+    {:ok, prior} = Schedules.upsert_schedule(2025, "2025–2026")
+
+    {:ok, prior_person} =
+      Residents.insert_resident(prior.id, %{
+        name: "Iris Reed",
+        resident_id: ctx.iris.resident_id,
+        position_code: "R1-1",
+        residency_year: 1,
+        schedule_number: 1
+      })
+
+    insert_labels(prior_person.id, ["Prior Clinic"], ~D[2025-12-29])
+    assert {:ok, ["Prior Clinic"]} = suggestions(%{academic_year: 2025, query: "clinic"})
+
+    assert {:ok, ["GOG Continuity Clinic PM"]} =
+             suggestions(%{
+               query: "clinic",
+               resident_id: ctx.iris.resident_id,
+               start_date: "2026-12-29",
+               end_date: "2026-12-29"
+             })
+
+    assert {:ok, []} = suggestions(%{query: "clinic", resident_id: ctx.stone.resident_id})
+  end
+
+  test "blank suggestions are deterministically sorted and limited before hydration", ctx do
+    insert_labels(
+      ctx.iris.id,
+      Enum.map(1..25, &("A Task " <> String.pad_leading(to_string(&1), 2, "0")))
+    )
+
+    owner = self()
+    handler = "activity-suggestions-#{System.unique_integer([:positive])}"
+
+    :telemetry.attach(
+      handler,
+      [:residency_schedule, :repo, :query],
+      fn _, _, metadata, _ ->
+        send(owner, {:suggestion_sql, metadata.query})
+      end,
+      nil
+    )
+
+    on_exit(fn -> :telemetry.detach(handler) end)
+    assert {:ok, labels} = suggestions(%{query: ""})
+    assert labels == Enum.map(1..20, &("A Task " <> String.pad_leading(to_string(&1), 2, "0")))
+    queries = collect_queries([])
+    task_queries = Enum.filter(queries, &String.contains?(&1, "detailed_activities"))
+    assert length(task_queries) == 1
+    [sql] = task_queries
+    assert sql =~ "DISTINCT"
+    assert sql =~ "LIMIT"
+    refute sql =~ "activity_sources"
+  end
+
+  test "invalid filters return errors rather than suggestions from a wider scope" do
+    for params <- [
+          %{},
+          %{academic_year: 9999},
+          %{academic_year: 2026, query: %{}},
+          %{academic_year: 2026, query: String.duplicate("x", 201)},
+          %{academic_year: 2026, resident_id: %{}},
+          %{academic_year: 2026, start_date: "bad"},
+          %{academic_year: 2026, start_date: "2027-01-03", end_date: "2026-12-28"}
+        ] do
+      assert {:error, message} = DetailedSchedules.activity_suggestions(params)
+      assert is_binary(message)
+    end
+  end
+
+  defp suggestions(params),
+    do: DetailedSchedules.activity_suggestions(Map.put_new(params, :academic_year, 2026))
+
+  defp insert_labels(schedule_resident_id, labels, date \\ ~D[2026-12-29]) do
+    Enum.each(labels, fn label ->
+      Repo.insert!(%Activity{
+        schedule_resident_id: schedule_resident_id,
+        date: date,
+        raw_task: label
+      })
+    end)
+  end
+
+  defp collect_queries(queries) do
+    receive do
+      {:suggestion_sql, query} -> collect_queries([query | queries])
+    after
+      0 -> Enum.reverse(queries)
+    end
+  end
+end

defmodule ResidencySchedule.ActivitySuggestionsTest do
  use ResidencySchedule.DataCase
  import ResidencySchedule.ActivitySearchFixtures
  alias ResidencySchedule.{DetailedSchedules, Residents, Schedules}
  alias ResidencySchedule.DetailedSchedules.Activity

    seed_activity_search()
  end

    assert {:ok, labels} = suggestions(%{query: "CLINIC"})
    assert labels == ["GOG Continuity Clinic AM", "GOG Continuity Clinic PM"]
    assert {:ok, []} = suggestions(%{query: "simulation"})
    assert {:ok, []} = suggestions(%{query: "Iris Reed"})
    assert {:ok, []} = suggestions(%{query: "Page 1"})
  end

  test "percent, underscore and backslash are literal substrings", ctx do
    insert_labels(ctx.iris.id, ["Literal 100% Clinic", "Literal clinic_A", "Literal C:\\Room", "Literal clinicXA"])
    assert {:ok, ["Literal 100% Clinic"]} = suggestions(%{query: "%"})
    assert {:ok, ["Literal clinic_A"]} = suggestions(%{query: "_"})
    assert {:ok, ["Literal C:\\Room"]} = suggestions(%{query: "\\"})
  end

  test "labels respect selected academic year, stable person and inclusive dates", ctx do
    {:ok, prior} = Schedules.upsert_schedule(2025, "2025–2026")
    {:ok, prior_person} = Residents.insert_resident(prior.id, %{name: "Iris Reed", resident_id: ctx.iris.resident_id,
      position_code: "R1-1", residency_year: 1, schedule_number: 1})
    insert_labels(prior_person.id, ["Prior Clinic"], ~D[2025-12-29])
    assert {:ok, ["Prior Clinic"]} = suggestions(%{academic_year: 2025, query: "clinic"})
    assert {:ok, ["GOG Continuity Clinic PM"]} = suggestions(%{query: "clinic", resident_id: ctx.iris.resident_id,
      start_date: "2026-12-29", end_date: "2026-12-29"})
    assert {:ok, []} = suggestions(%{query: "clinic", resident_id: ctx.stone.resident_id})
  end

  test "blank suggestions are deterministically sorted and limited before hydration", ctx do
    insert_labels(ctx.iris.id, Enum.map(1..25, &("A Task " <> String.pad_leading(to_string(&1), 2, "0"))))
    owner = self()
    handler = "activity-suggestions-#{System.unique_integer([:positive])}"
    :telemetry.attach(handler, [:residency_schedule, :repo, :query], fn _, _, metadata, _ ->
      send(owner, {:suggestion_sql, metadata.query})
    end, nil)
    on_exit(fn -> :telemetry.detach(handler) end)
    assert {:ok, labels} = suggestions(%{query: ""})
    assert labels == Enum.map(1..20, &("A Task " <> String.pad_leading(to_string(&1), 2, "0")))
    queries = collect_queries([])
    task_queries = Enum.filter(queries, &String.contains?(&1, "detailed_activities"))
    assert length(task_queries) == 1
    [sql] = task_queries
    assert sql =~ "DISTINCT"
    assert sql =~ "LIMIT"
    refute sql =~ "activity_sources"
  end

  test "invalid filters return errors rather than suggestions from a wider scope" do
    for params <- [%{}, %{academic_year: 9999}, %{academic_year: 2026, query: %{}},
      %{academic_year: 2026, query: String.duplicate("x", 201)},
      %{academic_year: 2026, resident_id: %{}}, %{academic_year: 2026, start_date: "bad"},
      %{academic_year: 2026, start_date: "2027-01-03", end_date: "2026-12-28"}] do
      assert {:error, message} = DetailedSchedules.activity_suggestions(params)
      assert is_binary(message)
    end
  end

  defp suggestions(params), do: DetailedSchedules.activity_suggestions(Map.put_new(params, :academic_year, 2026))

  defp insert_labels(schedule_resident_id, labels, date \\ ~D[2026-12-29]) do
    Enum.each(labels, fn label ->
      Repo.insert!(%Activity{schedule_resident_id: schedule_resident_id, date: date, raw_task: label})
    end)
  end

  defp collect_queries(queries) do
    receive do
      {:suggestion_sql, query} -> collect_queries([query | queries])
    after
      0 -> Enum.reverse(queries)
    end
  end
end

+defmodule ResidencySchedule.Observability do
+  @moduledoc """
+  Opt-in OTLP export of aggregate metrics and sanitized HTTP operation summaries.
+
+  Request bodies, paths, headers, query strings, database statements, and ordinary
+  application logs never enter this pipeline. Delivery is bounded and best effort.
+  """
+  use Supervisor
+  import Telemetry.Metrics
+
+  alias OtlpShipper.{Buffer, Config, Encoder, MetricsReporter, TraceExporter, Transport}
+
+  @methods ~w(GET HEAD POST PUT DELETE CONNECT OPTIONS TRACE PATCH)
+
+  @doc """
+  Returns the configured optional supervision child.
+
+      iex> ResidencySchedule.Observability.children()
+      []
+  """
+  def children do
+    config = Application.get_env(:residency_schedule, :observability, [])
+    if config[:enabled] == true, do: [{__MODULE__, config}], else: []
+  end
+
+  @doc """
+  Starts the export supervision tree with explicit collector options.
+
+      iex> opts = [endpoint: "http://localhost:4318", token: "example", environment: "test"]
+      iex> {:ok, pid} = ResidencySchedule.Observability.start_link(opts)
+      iex> Supervisor.stop(pid)
+      :ok
+  """
+  def start_link(opts), do: Supervisor.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
+
+  @doc """
+  Requests asynchronous export of pending signals; this does not confirm delivery.
+
+      iex> ResidencySchedule.Observability.flush()
+      :ok
+  """
+  def flush do
+    if Process.whereis(__MODULE__) do
+      __MODULE__.LogBuffer |> Buffer.handle() |> Buffer.flush()
+      MetricsReporter.flush(__MODULE__.Metrics)
+      :otel_tracer_provider.force_flush(__MODULE__.Traces)
+    end
+
+    :ok
+  end
+
+  @doc """
+  Selects bounded HTTP attributes from endpoint metadata.
+
+      iex> ResidencySchedule.Observability.request_attributes(%{conn: %{method: "GET", status: 200}})
+      %{"http.request.method" => "GET", "http.response.status_code" => 200}
+  """
+  def request_attributes(%{conn: %{method: method, status: status}}) do
+    %{"http.request.method" => if(method in @methods, do: method, else: "_OTHER")}
+    |> put_status(status)
+  end
+
+  def request_attributes(_), do: %{"http.request.method" => "_OTHER"}
+
+  @doc """
+  Defines tagless request, database, and VM aggregates.
+
+      iex> ResidencySchedule.Observability.metrics() |> Enum.all?(&(&1.tags == []))
+      true
+  """
+  def metrics do
+    [counter("phoenix.endpoint.stop.count", measurement: :duration)] ++
+      Enum.map(
+        ["phoenix.endpoint.stop.duration"] ++
+          Enum.map(~w(total_time query_time queue_time decode_time idle_time), fn timing ->
+            "residency_schedule.repo.query.#{timing}"
+          end),
+        &distribution(&1,
+          unit: {:native, :millisecond},
+          reporter_options: [buckets: [1, 5, 10, 25, 50, 100, 250, 500, 1000, 5000]]
+        )
+      ) ++
+      [last_value("vm.memory.total", unit: :byte)] ++
+      Enum.map(~w(total cpu io), &last_value("vm.total_run_queue_lengths.#{&1}"))
+  end
+
+  @impl true
+  def init(opts) do
+    shared = [
+      service_name: "residency-schedule",
+      resource: %{"deployment.environment.name" => Keyword.fetch!(opts, :environment)},
+      headers: [{"authorization", "Bearer " <> Keyword.fetch!(opts, :token)}],
+      flush_ms: Keyword.get(opts, :flush_ms, 5_000),
+      timeout: 5_000,
+      max_retries: 1,
+      max_queue: 2048,
+      max_batch: 256
+    ]
+
+    base = opts |> Keyword.fetch!(:endpoint) |> String.trim_trailing("/")
+    {:ok, log_config} = Config.new(:logs, Keyword.put(shared, :endpoint, base <> "/v1/logs"))
+
+    children = [
+      {Finch, name: __MODULE__.LogFinch, pools: %{default: [size: 1, count: 1]}},
+      {Buffer, name: __MODULE__.LogBuffer, config: log_config, export: log_export(log_config)},
+      {MetricsReporter,
+       shared ++
+         [
+           endpoint: base <> "/v1/metrics",
+           metrics: metrics(),
+           name: __MODULE__.Metrics,
+           finch_name: __MODULE__.MetricsFinch,
+           max_series: 16
+         ]},
+      TraceExporter.pool_child_spec(__MODULE__.TraceFinch),
+      trace_provider(base, shared),
+      __MODULE__.RequestHandler
+    ]
+
+    Supervisor.init(children, strategy: :rest_for_one)
+  end
+
+  defp put_status(attrs, status) when is_integer(status) and status in 100..599,
+    do: Map.put(attrs, "http.response.status_code", status)
+
+  defp put_status(attrs, _), do: attrs
+
+  defp log_export(config) do
+    fn records ->
+      with {:ok, body} <- Encoder.encode(:logs, records, config.resource) do
+        Transport.export(config, __MODULE__.LogFinch, body, length(records))
+      end
+    end
+  end
+
+  defp trace_provider(base, shared) do
+    resource =
+      shared[:resource]
+      |> Map.put("service.name", "residency-schedule")
+      |> :otel_resource.create()
+
+    batch = %{
+      name: __MODULE__.Traces,
+      resource: resource,
+      exporter:
+        {TraceExporter,
+         [pool: __MODULE__.TraceFinch, endpoint: base <> "/v1/traces"] ++
+           Keyword.take(shared, [:headers, :timeout, :max_retries, :max_batch])},
+      scheduled_delay_ms: shared[:flush_ms],
+      exporting_timeout_ms: 7_000,
+      max_queue_size: 2048
+    }
+
+    provider = %{
+      id_generator: :otel_id_generator,
+      sampler: {OtlpShipper.TraceSampler, :always_on},
+      processors: [{:otel_batch_processor, batch}],
+      deny_list: []
+    }
+
+    %{
+      id: __MODULE__.Traces,
+      type: :supervisor,
+      start: {:otel_tracer_server_sup, :start_link, [__MODULE__.Traces, resource, provider]}
+    }
+  end
+end

+defmodule ResidencySchedule.Observability.RequestHandler do
+  @moduledoc false
+  use GenServer
+
+  alias OtlpShipper.{Buffer, Value}
+  alias ResidencySchedule.Observability
+
+  @doc false
+  def start_link(_opts), do: GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, [], name: __MODULE__)
+
+  @impl true
+  def init(_) do
+    Process.flag(:trap_exit, true)
+
+    state = %{
+      buffer: Buffer.handle(Observability.LogBuffer),
+      tracer:
+        :otel_tracer_provider.get_tracer(
+          Observability.Traces,
+          "residency-schedule",
+          "0.1.0",
+          :undefined
+        )
+    }
+
+    :ok = :telemetry.attach(__MODULE__, [:phoenix, :endpoint, :stop], &__MODULE__.handle_event/4, state)
+    {:ok, state}
+  end
+
+  @doc """
+  Records a sanitized completed request when a valid duration is available.
+
+      iex> ResidencySchedule.Observability.RequestHandler.handle_event([], %{}, %{}, %{})
+      :ok
+  """
+  def handle_event(_, %{duration: duration}, metadata, state)
+      when is_integer(duration) and duration >= 0 do
+    attributes = Observability.request_attributes(metadata)
+    ended = :opentelemetry.timestamp()
+
+    span =
+      :otel_tracer.start_span(:otel_ctx.new(), state.tracer, "HTTP request", %{
+        kind: :server,
+        start_time: ended - duration,
+        attributes: attributes
+      })
+
+    :otel_span.end_span(span, ended)
+
+    Buffer.enqueue(state.buffer, %{
+      time_unix_nano: :opentelemetry.timestamp_to_nano(ended),
+      severity_number: 9,
+      severity_text: "info",
+      body: Value.encode("HTTP request completed"),
+      attributes: Value.attributes(attributes),
+      trace_id: <<:otel_span.trace_id(span)::128>>,
+      span_id: <<:otel_span.span_id(span)::64>>,
+      flags: 1
+    })
+
+    :ok
+  end
+
+  def handle_event(_, _, _, _), do: :ok
+
+  @impl true
+  def terminate(_, _) do
+    :telemetry.detach(__MODULE__)
+    :ok
+  end
+end

+defmodule ResidencySchedule.Rotations.FridayNightFloat do
+  @moduledoc "Derives Friday Strong night duty from literal imported assignments."
+
+  alias ResidencySchedule.DetailedSchedules.TaskEquivalence
+
+  @contact_nights for rank <- ~w(1st 2nd 3rd 4th),
+                      do: "SMH Obstetrics Resident #{rank} Contact Night"
+
+  @doc """
+  Projects complete schedule inputs without changing their stored records.
+  Approved coverage and explicit Strong night assignments take precedence.
+
+      iex> alias ResidencySchedule.Rotations.{FridayNightFloat, Rotation}
+      iex> alias ResidencySchedule.Residents.ScheduleResident
+      iex> person = %ScheduleResident{id: 1, schedule_id: 7}
+      iex> rotation = %Rotation{id: 2, schedule_resident_id: 1, schedule_resident: person, rotation_type: "ambulatory", start_date: ~D[2026-10-08], end_date: ~D[2026-10-10]}
+      iex> activity = %{schedule_resident_id: 1, date: ~D[2026-10-09], raw_task: "SMH Obstetrics Resident 1st Contact Night"}
+      iex> FridayNightFloat.project([rotation], [activity], []) |> Enum.map(&{&1.rotation_type, &1.start_date})
+      [{"ambulatory", ~D[2026-10-08]}, {"night_float", ~D[2026-10-09]}, {"ambulatory", ~D[2026-10-10]}]
+  """
+  def project(rotations, activities, overrides) do
+    protected = protected_dates(rotations, overrides)
+    by_day = Enum.group_by(activities, &{&1.schedule_resident_id, &1.date})
+    triggers = trigger_dates(rotations, by_day, protected)
+
+    Enum.flat_map(rotations, &project_rotation(&1, by_day, triggers, protected))
+  end
+
+  defp protected_dates(rotations, overrides) do
+    owners = Map.new(rotations, &{&1.id, &1.schedule_resident_id})
+
+    overrides
+    |> Enum.flat_map(fn override ->
+      for date <- Date.range(override.override_start_date, override.override_end_date),
+          resident <- [
+            Map.get(owners, override.rotation_id),
+            override.covering_schedule_resident_id
+          ],
+          not is_nil(resident),
+          do: {resident, date}
+    end)
+    |> MapSet.new()
+  end
+
+  defp trigger_dates(rotations, by_day, protected) do
+    rotations
+    |> Enum.filter(&(&1.rotation_type == "ambulatory"))
+    |> Enum.flat_map(fn rotation ->
+      rotation.start_date
+      |> Date.range(rotation.end_date)
+      |> Enum.filter(&contact_night?(rotation, &1, by_day, protected))
+      |> Enum.map(&{rotation.schedule_resident.schedule_id, &1})
+    end)
+    |> MapSet.new()
+  end
+
+  defp contact_night?(rotation, date, by_day, protected) do
+    key = {rotation.schedule_resident_id, date}
+
+    Date.day_of_week(date) == 5 and not MapSet.member?(protected, key) and
+      Enum.any?(Map.get(by_day, key, []), &(&1.raw_task in @contact_nights))
+  end
+
+  defp project_rotation(rotation, by_day, triggers, protected) do
+    rotation.start_date
+    |> Date.range(rotation.end_date)
+    |> Enum.chunk_by(&projected_type(rotation, &1, by_day, triggers, protected))
+    |> Enum.map(fn dates ->
+      first = hd(dates)
+      type = projected_type(rotation, first, by_day, triggers, protected)
+
+      %{
+        rotation
+        | start_date: first,
+          end_date: List.last(dates),
+          rotation_type: type,
+          source_assignment_date:
+            if(rotation.rotation_type == "ambulatory" and type == "night_float", do: first)
+      }
+    end)
+  end
+
+  defp projected_type(rotation, date, by_day, triggers, protected) do
+    key = {rotation.schedule_resident_id, date}
+
+    cond do
+      MapSet.member?(protected, key) ->
+        rotation.rotation_type
+
+      rotation.rotation_type == "ambulatory" and contact_night?(rotation, date, by_day, protected) ->
+        "night_float"
+
+      rotation.rotation_type == "night_float" and
+        MapSet.member?(triggers, {rotation.schedule_resident.schedule_id, date}) and
+          not explicit_strong_night?(Map.get(by_day, key, [])) ->
+        "post_call"
+
+      true ->
+        rotation.rotation_type
+    end
+  end
+
+  defp explicit_strong_night?(activities) do
+    Enum.any?(activities, fn activity ->
+      TaskEquivalence.matches_rotation?(activity.raw_task, "night_float") or
+        TaskEquivalence.matches_rotation?(activity.raw_task, "strong_weekend_nights")
+    end)
+  end
+end

+defmodule ResidencySchedule.Rotations.ScheduleGaps do
+  @moduledoc "Fills display-only schedule gaps from literal imported assignments."
+
+  alias ResidencySchedule.DetailedSchedules.TaskEquivalence
+  alias ResidencySchedule.Rotations.Rotation
+
+  @doc """
+  Adds dated assignments only where neither a base rotation nor coverage exists.
+  Activities carry their loaded schedule resident; no synthetic database ID is assigned.
+
+      iex> resident = %{id: 7}
+      iex> activity = %{schedule_resident_id: 7, schedule_resident: resident, date: ~D[2026-10-10], raw_task: "Vacation"}
+      iex> [entry] = ResidencySchedule.Rotations.ScheduleGaps.project([], [activity], [])
+      iex> {entry.rotation_type, entry.source_tasks, entry.id}
+      {"vacation", ["Vacation"], nil}
+  """
+  def project(rotations, activities, overrides) do
+    bases = Enum.group_by(rotations, & &1.schedule_resident_id)
+    coverage = Enum.group_by(overrides, & &1.covering_schedule_resident_id)
+
+    added =
+      activities
+      |> Enum.reject(fn activity ->
+        Enum.any?(
+          Map.get(bases, activity.schedule_resident_id, []),
+          &(activity.date in Date.range(&1.start_date, &1.end_date))
+        ) or
+          Enum.any?(
+            Map.get(coverage, activity.schedule_resident_id, []),
+            &(activity.date in Date.range(&1.override_start_date, &1.override_end_date))
+          )
+      end)
+      |> Enum.group_by(
+        &{&1.schedule_resident_id, &1.date, TaskEquivalence.gap_type(&1.raw_task, &1.date)}
+      )
+      |> Enum.map(fn {{resident_id, date, type}, tasks} ->
+        %Rotation{
+          schedule_resident_id: resident_id,
+          schedule_resident: hd(tasks).schedule_resident,
+          rotation_type: type,
+          start_date: date,
+          end_date: date,
+          slot_index: -1,
+          source_assignment_date: date,
+          source_tasks: tasks |> Enum.map(& &1.raw_task) |> Enum.uniq()
+        }
+      end)
+
+    Enum.sort_by(
+      rotations ++ added,
+      &{Date.to_gregorian_days(&1.start_date), &1.schedule_resident_id, &1.rotation_type}
+    )
+  end
+end

+defmodule ResidencyScheduleWeb.FridayNightFloatTest do
+  use ResidencyScheduleWeb.ConnCase
+
+  import Phoenix.LiveViewTest

+    Assistant,
+    DetailedSchedules,
+    Repo,
+    Residents,
+    Rotations,
+    Schedules,
+    ShiftOverrides
+  }
+
+  alias ResidencySchedule.DetailedSchedules.{Activity, ActivitySource, ImportBatch}
+
+  doctest ResidencySchedule.Rotations.FridayNightFloat
+
+  @friday ~D[2026-10-09]
+
+  setup :authenticate_session
+
+  setup do
+    {:ok, schedule} = Schedules.upsert_schedule(2026, "2026–2027")
+
+    people =
+      [
+        {:alder, "Alder", :ambulatory},
+        {:birch, "Birch", :ambulatory},
+        {:cedar, "Cedar", :night_float},
+        {:dogwood, "Dogwood", :night_float},
+        {:elm, "Elm", :highland_night_float},
+        {:fern, "Fern", :night_float},
+        {:hazel, "Hazel", :elective}
+      ]
+      |> Enum.with_index(1)
+      |> Map.new(fn {{key, name, type}, number} ->
+        {:ok, resident} =
+          Residents.insert_resident(schedule.id, %{
+            name: name,
+            position_code: "R2-#{number}",
+            residency_year: 2,
+            schedule_number: number
+          })
+
+        insert_rotation(resident, type, ~D[2026-10-05], ~D[2026-10-11])
+        {key, resident}
+      end)
+
+    admin = ResidencySchedule.ScheduleFixtures.admin_user()
+
+    batch =
+      Repo.insert!(%ImportBatch{
+        schedule_id: schedule.id,
+        created_by_id: admin.id,
+        fingerprint: Ecto.UUID.generate(),
+        header_start: ~D[2026-10-05],
+        header_end: ~D[2026-10-11]
+      })
+
+    Map.merge(people, %{schedule: schedule, batch: batch})
+  end
+
+  for rank <- ["1st", "2nd", "3rd", "4th"] do
+    test "one Ambulatory #{rank} Contact Night assignment corrects Friday for the whole usual Strong team",
+         ctx do
+      task = "SMH Obstetrics Resident #{unquote(rank)} Contact Night"
+      add_activity(ctx, ctx.alder, @friday, task)
+      raw = Rotations.list_rotations_for_resident(ctx.alder.id)
+      source = DetailedSchedules.list_for_resident(ctx.alder.id, @friday)
+
+      assert spans(ctx.alder) == [
+               {"ambulatory", ~D[2026-10-05], ~D[2026-10-08]},
+               {"night_float", @friday, @friday},
+               {"ambulatory", ~D[2026-10-10], ~D[2026-10-11]}
+             ]
+
+      for resident <- [ctx.cedar, ctx.dogwood, ctx.fern] do
+        assert spans(resident) == [
+                 {"night_float", ~D[2026-10-05], ~D[2026-10-08]},
+                 {"post_call", @friday, @friday},
+                 {"night_float", ~D[2026-10-10], ~D[2026-10-11]}
+               ]
+      end
+
+      assert spans(ctx.birch) == [{"ambulatory", ~D[2026-10-05], ~D[2026-10-11]}]
+      assert spans(ctx.elm) == [{"highland_night_float", ~D[2026-10-05], ~D[2026-10-11]}]
+      assert Rotations.list_rotations_for_resident(ctx.alder.id) == raw
+      assert DetailedSchedules.list_for_resident(ctx.alder.id, @friday) == source
+    end
+  end
+
+  test "non-Friday, wrong task, unknown contact rank and non-Ambulatory sources do not trigger correction",
+       ctx do
+    for {resident, date, task} <- [
+          {ctx.alder, ~D[2026-10-08], "SMH Obstetrics Resident 1st Contact Night"},
+          {ctx.alder, @friday, "SMH Gynecology Chief On Call Night"},
+          {ctx.alder, @friday, "SMH Obstetrics Resident 1st Contact Day"},
+          {ctx.alder, @friday, "SMH Obstetrics Resident 5th Contact Night"},
+          {ctx.alder, @friday, "HH Nights 3rd Call"},
+          {ctx.hazel, @friday, "SMH Obstetrics Resident 2nd Contact Night"}
+        ] do
+      add_activity(ctx, resident, date, task)
+    end
+
+    assert spans(ctx.alder) == [{"ambulatory", ~D[2026-10-05], ~D[2026-10-11]}]
+    assert spans(ctx.cedar) == [{"night_float", ~D[2026-10-05], ~D[2026-10-11]}]
+  end
+
+  test "explicit same-day night duty and approved coverage take precedence over the usual-team correction",
+       ctx do
+    add_activity(ctx, ctx.alder, @friday, "SMH Obstetrics Resident 1st Contact Night")
+    add_activity(ctx, ctx.fern, @friday, "SMH Obstetrics Resident 4th Contact Night")
+    [rotation] = Rotations.list_rotations_for_resident(ctx.cedar.id)
+
+    {:ok, _} =
+      ShiftOverrides.create_override(%{

+        override_end_date: @friday

+
+    assert day_type(ctx.fern, @friday) == "night_float"
+    assert day_type(ctx.dogwood, @friday) == "post_call"
+
+    cedar =

+    assert Enum.any?(

+             &(&1.is_coverage and &1.rotation_type == "night_float" and &1.start_date == @friday)
+           )
+  end
+
+  test "projection is scoped to schedule identity and removal of evidence restores the unsplit block",
+       ctx do
+    activity = add_activity(ctx, ctx.alder, @friday, "SMH Obstetrics Resident 1st Contact Night")
+    {:ok, other_schedule} = Schedules.upsert_schedule(2025, "2025–2026")
+
+    {:ok, other} =
+      Residents.insert_resident(other_schedule.id, %{
+        name: "Alder",
+        resident_id: ctx.alder.resident_id,
+        position_code: "R1-1",
+        residency_year: 1,
+        schedule_number: 1
+      })
+
+    # Deliberately overlapping dates exercise schedule identity independently of date matching.
+    insert_rotation(other, :night_float, ~D[2026-10-05], ~D[2026-10-11])
+    assert day_type(other, @friday) == "night_float"

+defmodule ResidencyScheduleWeb.ResidentImportedScheduleTest do
+  use ResidencyScheduleWeb.ConnCase
+
+  import Phoenix.LiveViewTest
+  import ResidencySchedule.QgendaDetailFixtures
+
+  alias ResidencySchedule.{DetailedSchedules, Residents, Rotations, Schedules}
+
+  doctest ResidencyScheduleWeb.ResidentLive.Show
+
+  setup :authenticate_session
+
+  setup do
+    data = seed_detail_roster()
+
+    {:ok, _} =
+      Rotations.insert_rotations(data.iris.id, [
+        %{
+          slot_index: 1,
+          start_date: ~D[2026-10-05],

+          rotation_type: :strong_gynecology
+        }
+      ])

+    {:ok, preview} = detail_preview(october_workbook())

+
+  test "imported Saturday night call appears in the main schedule without any base rotation",
+       ctx do
+    assert Rotations.list_rotations_for_resident(ctx.juniper.id) == []

+    {:ok, view, _} = live(ctx.conn, "/residents/#{ctx.juniper.id}")
+
+    assert has_element?(view, "#rotation-table tbody tr", "HH Nights 3rd Call")
+    assert has_element?(view, "#rotation-table tbody tr", ~r/HH Nights 3rd Call.*Oct 10, 2026/s)
+    refute has_element?(view, "#rotation-table tbody tr", "Mystery Service")
+    refute has_element?(view, "#rotation-table tbody tr", "Vacation")
+  end
+
+  test "activity days split an otherwise OFF week without deleting the remaining OFF dates",
+       ctx do
+    {:ok, view, _} = live(ctx.conn, "/residents/#{ctx.juniper.id}")
+
+    assert has_element?(view, off_row("2026-10-05", "2026-10-06"))
+    assert has_element?(view, off_row("2026-10-08", "2026-10-09"))

+    refute has_element?(view, off_row("2026-10-05", "2026-10-11"))
+
+    # Inspect every OFF interval, so a duplicate unsplit interval cannot pass.
+    off_rows =
+      view
+      |> render()
+      |> LazyHTML.from_fragment()
+      |> LazyHTML.query("#rotation-table tr[data-rotation-type='off']")
+
+    intervals =
+      Enum.zip(
+        LazyHTML.attribute(off_rows, "phx-value-start-date"),
+        LazyHTML.attribute(off_rows, "phx-value-end-date")
+      )
+
+    for {start_date, end_date} <- intervals,
+        activity_date <- [~D[2026-10-07], ~D[2026-10-10]] do
+      refute activity_date in Date.range(
+               Date.from_iso8601!(start_date),
+               Date.from_iso8601!(end_date)
+             )
+    end
+  end
+
+  test "multiple literal tasks on one date remain alongside the base rotation", ctx do
+    {:ok, view, _} = live(ctx.conn, "/residents/#{ctx.iris.id}")
+
+    for task <- ["SMH GYN R2 Day", "HH Nights 3rd Call", "Vacation"] do
+      assert has_element?(

+               "#rotation-table tbody tr",
+               Regex.compile!("#{task}.*Oct 5, 2026", "s")

+    end
+
+    assert has_element?(
+             view,
+             "#rotation-entry-strong_gynecology-1-2026-10-07-2026-10-11"

+
+    refute has_element?(view, "#rotation-table tbody tr", "Sick Backup")
+    refute has_element?(view, "#rotation-table tbody tr", "Mystery Service")
+  end

+  test "opening an older appearance includes the person's later imported schedule", ctx do
+    {:ok, older_schedule} = Schedules.upsert_schedule(2025, "2025–2026")
+
+    {:ok, older} =
+      Residents.insert_resident(older_schedule.id, %{
+        name: "Juniper Vail",
+        resident_id: ctx.juniper.resident_id,
+        position_code: "R1-2",
+        residency_year: 1,
+        schedule_number: 2

+
+    {:ok, _} =
+      Rotations.insert_rotations(older.id, [

+    {:ok, view, _} = live(ctx.conn, "/residents/#{older.id}")

+    assert has_element?(view, "#rotation-table tbody tr", ~r/HH Nights 3rd Call.*Oct 10, 2026/s)
+    refute has_element?(view, "#rotation-table tbody tr", "Mystery Service")
+  end
+
+  test "daily assignments have their own filter and do not open rotation coworkers", ctx do
+    {:ok, view, _} = live(ctx.conn, "/residents/#{ctx.iris.id}")

+
+    refute has_element?(view, "#rotation-table tr[data-rotation-type='strong_gynecology']")
+    refute has_element?(view, "#rotation-table tr[data-rotation-type='off']")

+    render_click(view, "open_shift_coworkers", %{

+
+    refute has_element?(view, "#shift-coworkers-modal")

+defmodule ResidencyScheduleWeb.ResidentSpecificRotationsTest do
+  use ResidencyScheduleWeb.ConnCase
+  import Phoenix.LiveViewTest
+  import ResidencySchedule.QgendaDetailFixtures
+
+  alias ResidencySchedule.{DetailedSchedules, Residents, Rotations, Schedules, ShiftOverrides}
+
+  doctest ResidencySchedule.DetailedSchedules.TaskEquivalence
+
+  setup :authenticate_session
+
+  setup do
+    data = seed_detail_roster()
+    {:ok, preview} = detail_preview()
+    {:ok, _} = DetailedSchedules.commit(preview, ResidencySchedule.ScheduleFixtures.admin_user())
+    data
+  end
+
+  for {task, type, base_label} <- [
+        {"Vacation", :vacation, "Vacation"},
+        {"Ambulatory R4", :ambulatory, "Ambulatory"}
+      ] do
+    test "#{task} uses the same bounded centered pill style as its base rotation", ctx do
+      task = unquote(task)
+      type = unquote(type)
+      base_label = unquote(base_label)
+
+      workbook =
+        mutate_detail_workbook(
+          "xl/sharedStrings.xml",
+          &String.replace(&1, "SMH GYN R2 Day", task)
+        )
+
+      {:ok, preview} = detail_preview(workbook)
+
+      {:ok, _} =
+        DetailedSchedules.commit(preview, ResidencySchedule.ScheduleFixtures.admin_user())
+
+      {:ok, _} =
+        Rotations.insert_rotations(ctx.iris.id, [
+          %{
+            slot_index: 1,
+            start_date: ~D[2026-12-28],
+            end_date: ~D[2027-01-03],
+            rotation_type: type
+          }
+        ])
+
+      {:ok, view, _} = live(ctx.conn, "/residents/#{ctx.iris.id}")
+      specific_row = rotation_row(type, "2026-12-28", "2026-12-29")
+      specific_pill = specific_row <> " [data-role='specific-rotation-label']"
+      base_pill = rotation_row(type, "2026-12-30", "2027-01-03") <> " span[title='#{base_label}']"
+      assert has_element?(view, specific_pill, task)
+      assert has_element?(view, base_pill, base_label)
+      assert pill_classes(view, specific_pill) == pill_classes(view, base_pill)
+
+      for token <- [
+            "w-full",
+            "max-w-[11rem]",
+            "min-h-8",
+            "justify-center",
+            "text-center",
+            "items-center",
+            "whitespace-normal",
+            "break-words",
+            "px-2"
+          ] do
+        assert token in pill_classes(view, specific_pill)
+      end
+
+      refute "truncate" in pill_classes(view, specific_pill)
+      assert has_element?(view, specific_row <> " p", "Coverage discussion")
+      refute has_element?(view, specific_pill, "Coverage discussion")
+    end
+  end
+
+  test "specific tasks replace matching general labels only on their actual dates", ctx do
+    before = Rotations.list_rotations_for_resident(ctx.iris.id)
+    {:ok, view, _} = live(ctx.conn, "/residents/#{ctx.iris.id}")
+
+    for date <- ["2026-12-28", "2026-12-29"] do
+      refute has_element?(view, activity_row(date), "SMH GYN R2 Day")
+    end
+
+    selector = rotation_row("strong_gynecology", "2026-12-28", "2026-12-29")
+    assert has_element?(view, selector, "SMH GYN R2 Day")
+
+    assert has_element?(
+             view,
+             selector <> " [data-role='specific-rotation-label']",
+             "SMH GYN R2 Day"
+           )
+
+    refute has_element?(view, selector <> " [data-role='specific-rotation-label'].truncate")
+
+    refute has_element?(
+             view,
+             selector <> " [data-role='specific-rotation-label'][class*='line-clamp']"
+           )
+
+    refute has_element?(view, selector <> " span[title='Gynecology – Strong Memorial']")
+
+    assert has_element?(
+             view,
+             rotation_row("strong_gynecology", "2026-12-30", "2027-01-03"),
+             "Gynecology – Strong Memorial"
+           )
+
+    assert has_element?(view, selector, "Coverage discussion")
+    assert has_element?(view, activity_row("2026-12-29"), "GOG Continuity Clinic PM")
+    assert has_element?(view, activity_row("2026-12-29"), "Bring simulation kit")
+    assert has_element?(view, activity_row("2026-12-28"), "Vacation")
+
+    assert has_element?(
+             view,
+             "div[title='Total scheduled shift days (excludes vacation)']",
+             ~r/Total Shifts\s+7/
+           )
+
+    assert Rotations.list_rotations_for_resident(ctx.iris.id) == before
+
+    assert Enum.any?(
+             DetailedSchedules.list_for_resident(ctx.iris.id, ~D[2026-12-29]),
+             &(&1.raw_task == "SMH GYN R2 Day")
+           )
+
+    view |> element("#service-filter-toggle") |> render_click()
+
+    view
+    |> element("#service-filter-panel button[phx-value-service='strong_gynecology']")
+    |> render_click()
+
+    assert has_element?(view, selector, "SMH GYN R2 Day")
+    refute has_element?(view, activity_row("2026-12-29"))

+      emit_operation(operation, milliseconds, metadata)

+        socket: %Phoenix.LiveView.Socket{view: ResidencyScheduleWeb.CompareLive.Index},

+        session: %{},

+    :telemetry.execute(

+
+    :telemetry.execute(
+      [:residency_schedule, :repo, :query],

+        total_time: native(12),
+        query_time: native(12),
+        queue_time: 0,
+        decode_time: 0,
+        idle_time: 0
+      },
+      %{}
+    )
+
+    :telemetry.execute([:vm, :memory], %{total: 4096}, %{})
+    :telemetry.execute([:vm, :total_run_queue_lengths], %{total: 3, cpu: 2, io: 1}, %{})

+      assert Enum.sort(Enum.map(points, &attributes(&1.attributes))) == [

+    plug = fn conn, _ ->

+      body =
+        if Plug.Conn.get_req_header(conn, "content-encoding") == ["gzip"],
+          do: :zlib.gunzip(body),

+      send(owner, {:export, conn.request_path, body})
+      Plug.Conn.send_resp(conn, 200, "")

+    server =

+  defp attributes(values),
+    do: Map.new(values, fn %{key: key, value: %{value: {_, value}}} -> {key, value} end)
+end

+
+      iex> ResidencySchedule.DetailedSchedules.TaskEquivalence.matches_rotation?("SMH GYN R2 Day", "strong_gynecology")
+      true
+
+      iex> ResidencySchedule.DetailedSchedules.TaskEquivalence.matches_rotation?("HH Nights 3rd Call", "highland_night_float")
+      true
+
+      iex> ResidencySchedule.DetailedSchedules.TaskEquivalence.matches_rotation?("HH Nights 3rd Call", "highland_weekend_days")
+      false
+
+      iex> ResidencySchedule.DetailedSchedules.TaskEquivalence.matches_rotation?("Unreviewed task", nil)
+      false
+  """
+  def matches_rotation?(task, type), do: type in Map.get(@equivalents, task, [])
+
+  @doc """
+  Classifies a task without a base rotation only when its reviewed meaning is unique.
+
+      iex> ResidencySchedule.DetailedSchedules.TaskEquivalence.gap_type("Vacation", ~D[2026-10-10])
+      "vacation"
+
+      iex> ResidencySchedule.DetailedSchedules.TaskEquivalence.gap_type("HH Nights 3rd Call", ~D[2026-10-10])
+      "highland_weekend_nights"
+
+      iex> ResidencySchedule.DetailedSchedules.TaskEquivalence.gap_type("SMH Obstetrics Resident 1st Contact Night", ~D[2026-10-10])
+      "qgenda_assignment"
+  """
+  def gap_type(task, date) do
+    case Map.get(@equivalents, task, []) do
+      [type] ->
+        type
+
+      ["highland_weekend_nights", "highland_night_float"] ->
+        if Date.day_of_week(date) == 6, do: "highland_weekend_nights", else: "qgenda_assignment"
+
+      _ ->
+        "qgenda_assignment"
+    end
+  end
+end

+defmodule ResidencySchedule.Rotations.FridayNightFloat do
+  @moduledoc "Derives Friday Strong night duty from literal imported assignments."
+
+  alias ResidencySchedule.DetailedSchedules.TaskEquivalence
+
+  @contact_nights for rank <- ~w(1st 2nd 3rd 4th),
+                      do: "SMH Obstetrics Resident #{rank} Contact Night"
+
+  @doc """
+  Projects complete schedule inputs without changing their stored records.
+  Approved coverage and explicit Strong night assignments take precedence.
+
+      iex> alias ResidencySchedule.Rotations.{FridayNightFloat, Rotation}
+      iex> alias ResidencySchedule.Residents.ScheduleResident
+      iex> person = %ScheduleResident{id: 1, schedule_id: 7}
+      iex> rotation = %Rotation{id: 2, schedule_resident_id: 1, schedule_resident: person, rotation_type: "ambulatory", start_date: ~D[2026-10-08], end_date: ~D[2026-10-10]}
+      iex> activity = %{schedule_resident_id: 1, date: ~D[2026-10-09], raw_task: "SMH Obstetrics Resident 1st Contact Night"}
+      iex> FridayNightFloat.project([rotation], [activity], []) |> Enum.map(&{&1.rotation_type, &1.start_date})
+      [{"ambulatory", ~D[2026-10-08]}, {"night_float", ~D[2026-10-09]}, {"ambulatory", ~D[2026-10-10]}]
+  """
+  def project(rotations, activities, overrides) do
+    protected = protected_dates(rotations, overrides)
+    by_day = Enum.group_by(activities, &{&1.schedule_resident_id, &1.date})
+    triggers = trigger_dates(rotations, by_day, protected)
+
+    Enum.flat_map(rotations, &project_rotation(&1, by_day, triggers, protected))
+  end
+
+  defp protected_dates(rotations, overrides) do
+    owners = Map.new(rotations, &{&1.id, &1.schedule_resident_id})
+
+    overrides
+    |> Enum.flat_map(fn override ->
+      for date <- Date.range(override.override_start_date, override.override_end_date),
+          resident <- [
+            Map.get(owners, override.rotation_id),
+            override.covering_schedule_resident_id
+          ],
+          not is_nil(resident),
+          do: {resident, date}
+    end)
+    |> MapSet.new()
+  end
+
+  defp trigger_dates(rotations, by_day, protected) do
+    rotations
+    |> Enum.filter(&(&1.rotation_type == "ambulatory"))
+    |> Enum.flat_map(fn rotation ->
+      rotation.start_date
+      |> Date.range(rotation.end_date)
+      |> Enum.filter(&contact_night?(rotation, &1, by_day, protected))
+      |> Enum.map(&{rotation.schedule_resident.schedule_id, &1})
+    end)
+    |> MapSet.new()
+  end
+
+  defp contact_night?(rotation, date, by_day, protected) do
+    key = {rotation.schedule_resident_id, date}
+
+    Date.day_of_week(date) == 5 and not MapSet.member?(protected, key) and
+      Enum.any?(Map.get(by_day, key, []), &(&1.raw_task in @contact_nights))
+  end
+
+  defp project_rotation(rotation, by_day, triggers, protected) do
+    rotation.start_date
+    |> Date.range(rotation.end_date)
+    |> Enum.chunk_by(&projected_type(rotation, &1, by_day, triggers, protected))
+    |> Enum.map(fn dates ->
+      first = hd(dates)
+      type = projected_type(rotation, first, by_day, triggers, protected)
+
+      %{
+        rotation
+        | start_date: first,
+          end_date: List.last(dates),
+          rotation_type: type,
+          source_assignment_date:
+            if(rotation.rotation_type == "ambulatory" and type == "night_float", do: first)
+      }
+    end)
+  end
+
+  defp projected_type(rotation, date, by_day, triggers, protected) do
+    key = {rotation.schedule_resident_id, date}
+
+    cond do
+      MapSet.member?(protected, key) ->
+        rotation.rotation_type
+
+      rotation.rotation_type == "ambulatory" and contact_night?(rotation, date, by_day, protected) ->
+        "night_float"
+
+      rotation.rotation_type == "night_float" and
+        MapSet.member?(triggers, {rotation.schedule_resident.schedule_id, date}) and
+          not explicit_strong_night?(Map.get(by_day, key, [])) ->
+        "post_call"
+
+      true ->
+        rotation.rotation_type
+    end
+  end
+
+  defp explicit_strong_night?(activities) do
+    Enum.any?(activities, fn activity ->
+      TaskEquivalence.matches_rotation?(activity.raw_task, "night_float") or
+        TaskEquivalence.matches_rotation?(activity.raw_task, "strong_weekend_nights")
+    end)
+  end
+end

+defmodule ResidencySchedule.Rotations.ScheduleGaps do
+  @moduledoc "Fills display-only schedule gaps from literal imported assignments."
+
+  alias ResidencySchedule.DetailedSchedules.TaskEquivalence
+  alias ResidencySchedule.Rotations.Rotation
+
+  @doc """
+  Adds dated assignments only where neither a base rotation nor coverage exists.
+  Activities carry their loaded schedule resident; no synthetic database ID is assigned.
+
+      iex> resident = %{id: 7}
+      iex> activity = %{schedule_resident_id: 7, schedule_resident: resident, date: ~D[2026-10-10], raw_task: "Vacation"}
+      iex> [entry] = ResidencySchedule.Rotations.ScheduleGaps.project([], [activity], [])
+      iex> {entry.rotation_type, entry.source_tasks, entry.id}
+      {"vacation", ["Vacation"], nil}
+  """
+  def project(rotations, activities, overrides) do
+    bases = Enum.group_by(rotations, & &1.schedule_resident_id)
+    coverage = Enum.group_by(overrides, & &1.covering_schedule_resident_id)
+
+    added =
+      activities
+      |> Enum.reject(fn activity ->
+        Enum.any?(
+          Map.get(bases, activity.schedule_resident_id, []),
+          &(activity.date in Date.range(&1.start_date, &1.end_date))
+        ) or
+          Enum.any?(
+            Map.get(coverage, activity.schedule_resident_id, []),
+            &(activity.date in Date.range(&1.override_start_date, &1.override_end_date))
+          )
+      end)
+      |> Enum.group_by(
+        &{&1.schedule_resident_id, &1.date, TaskEquivalence.gap_type(&1.raw_task, &1.date)}
+      )
+      |> Enum.map(fn {{resident_id, date, type}, tasks} ->
+        %Rotation{
+          schedule_resident_id: resident_id,
+          schedule_resident: hd(tasks).schedule_resident,
+          rotation_type: type,
+          start_date: date,
+          end_date: date,
+          slot_index: -1,
+          source_assignment_date: date,
+          source_tasks: tasks |> Enum.map(& &1.raw_task) |> Enum.uniq()
+        }
+      end)
+
+    Enum.sort_by(
+      rotations ++ added,
+      &{Date.to_gregorian_days(&1.start_date), &1.schedule_resident_id, &1.rotation_type}
+    )
+  end
+end

+defmodule ResidencyScheduleWeb.CalendarHighlandAssignmentsTest do
+  use ResidencyScheduleWeb.ConnCase
+
+  import Phoenix.LiveViewTest
+  import ResidencySchedule.QgendaDetailFixtures
+
+  alias ResidencySchedule.{DetailedSchedules, Rotations, ShiftOverrides}
+
+  @night_type "highland_weekend_nights"
+  @label "Weekend Nights – Highland"
+  @day "2026-10-10"
+
+  setup :authenticate_session
+
+  setup do
+    seed_detail_roster()
+  end
+
+  test "each approved Saturday task appears under Highland weekend nights in day and modal views",
+       ctx do
+    for task <- ["HH Nights 2nd Call", "HH Nights 3rd Call", "HH Nights Extra"] do
+      import_task(task)
+
+      for mode <- ["day", "month"] do
+        {:ok, view, _} = live(ctx.conn, "/calendar?view=#{mode}&date=#{@day}")
+        if mode == "month", do: open_day(view)
+
+        assert has_element?(view, group() <> " > h3", @label)
+        assert has_element?(view, group() <> " > h3", "1 resident")
+        assert has_element?(view, person(ctx.juniper), task)
+
+        assert has_element?(
+                 view,
+                 person(ctx.juniper) <> " a[href='/residents/#{ctx.juniper.id}']"
+               )
+      end
+
+      activities = DetailedSchedules.list_for_resident(ctx.juniper.id, ~D[2026-10-10])
+      assert Enum.any?(activities, &(&1.raw_task == task and &1.date == ~D[2026-10-10]))
+      assert Rotations.list_rotations_for_resident(ctx.juniper.id) == []
+    end
+  end
+
+  test "month dots, weekly unique counts, and filter options include imported Saturday nights",
+       ctx do
+    import_task("HH Nights 3rd Call")
+    {:ok, month, _} = live(ctx.conn, "/calendar?view=month&date=#{@day}")
+    assert has_element?(month, day_cell() <> " span[title='#{@label}']")
+    render_click(month, "toggle_resident_filter", %{"id" => to_string(ctx.iris.resident_id)})
+    refute has_element?(month, day_cell() <> " span[title='#{@label}']")
+    render_click(month, "toggle_resident_filter", %{"id" => to_string(ctx.iris.resident_id)})
+    render_click(month, "toggle_resident_filter", %{"id" => to_string(ctx.juniper.resident_id)})
+    assert has_element?(month, day_cell() <> " span[title='#{@label}']")
+
+    {:ok, week, _} = live(ctx.conn, "/calendar?view=week&date=#{@day}")
+    assert has_element?(week, day_cell(), @label)
+    assert has_element?(week, day_cell() <> " .font-mono", "1")
+
+    render_click(week, "toggle_filter_panel", %{"panel" => "rotations"})
+
+    assert has_element?(
+             week,
+             "button[data-action='toggle_rotation_filter'][phx-value-type='#{@night_type}']",
+             @label
+           )
+
+    render_click(week, "toggle_rotation_filter", %{"type" => @night_type})
+    open_day(week)

+defmodule ResidencyScheduleWeb.FridayNightFloatTest do
+  use ResidencyScheduleWeb.ConnCase
+
+  import Phoenix.LiveViewTest
+
+  alias ResidencySchedule.{
+    Assistant,
+    DetailedSchedules,
+    Repo,
+    Residents,

+  alias ResidencySchedule.DetailedSchedules.{Activity, ActivitySource, ImportBatch}

+  doctest ResidencySchedule.Rotations.FridayNightFloat

+  @friday ~D[2026-10-09]

+  setup :authenticate_session
+
+  setup do
+    {:ok, schedule} = Schedules.upsert_schedule(2026, "2026–2027")
+
+    people =
+      [
+        {:alder, "Alder", :ambulatory},
+        {:birch, "Birch", :ambulatory},
+        {:cedar, "Cedar", :night_float},
+        {:dogwood, "Dogwood", :night_float},
+        {:elm, "Elm", :highland_night_float},
+        {:fern, "Fern", :night_float},
+        {:hazel, "Hazel", :elective}
+      ]
+      |> Enum.with_index(1)
+      |> Map.new(fn {{key, name, type}, number} ->
+        {:ok, resident} =
+          Residents.insert_resident(schedule.id, %{
+            name: name,
+            position_code: "R2-#{number}",
+            residency_year: 2,
+            schedule_number: number
+          })
+
+        insert_rotation(resident, type, ~D[2026-10-05], ~D[2026-10-11])
+        {key, resident}
+      end)
+
+    admin = ResidencySchedule.ScheduleFixtures.admin_user()
+
+    batch =
+      Repo.insert!(%ImportBatch{
+        schedule_id: schedule.id,
+        created_by_id: admin.id,
+        fingerprint: Ecto.UUID.generate(),
+        header_start: ~D[2026-10-05],
+        header_end: ~D[2026-10-11]
+      })
+
+    Map.merge(people, %{schedule: schedule, batch: batch})
+  end
+
+  for rank <- ["1st", "2nd", "3rd", "4th"] do
+    test "one Ambulatory #{rank} Contact Night assignment corrects Friday for the whole usual Strong team",
+         ctx do
+      task = "SMH Obstetrics Resident #{unquote(rank)} Contact Night"
+      add_activity(ctx, ctx.alder, @friday, task)
+      raw = Rotations.list_rotations_for_resident(ctx.alder.id)
+      source = DetailedSchedules.list_for_resident(ctx.alder.id, @friday)
+
+      assert spans(ctx.alder) == [
+               {"ambulatory", ~D[2026-10-05], ~D[2026-10-08]},
+               {"night_float", @friday, @friday},
+               {"ambulatory", ~D[2026-10-10], ~D[2026-10-11]}
+             ]
+
+      for resident <- [ctx.cedar, ctx.dogwood, ctx.fern] do
+        assert spans(resident) == [
+                 {"night_float", ~D[2026-10-05], ~D[2026-10-08]},
+                 {"post_call", @friday, @friday},
+                 {"night_float", ~D[2026-10-10], ~D[2026-10-11]}
+               ]
+      end
+
+      assert spans(ctx.birch) == [{"ambulatory", ~D[2026-10-05], ~D[2026-10-11]}]
+      assert spans(ctx.elm) == [{"highland_night_float", ~D[2026-10-05], ~D[2026-10-11]}]
+      assert Rotations.list_rotations_for_resident(ctx.alder.id) == raw
+      assert DetailedSchedules.list_for_resident(ctx.alder.id, @friday) == source
+    end
+  end
+
+  test "non-Friday, wrong task, unknown contact rank and non-Ambulatory sources do not trigger correction",
+       ctx do
+    for {resident, date, task} <- [
+          {ctx.alder, ~D[2026-10-08], "SMH Obstetrics Resident 1st Contact Night"},
+          {ctx.alder, @friday, "SMH Gynecology Chief On Call Night"},
+          {ctx.alder, @friday, "SMH Obstetrics Resident 1st Contact Day"},
+          {ctx.alder, @friday, "SMH Obstetrics Resident 5th Contact Night"},
+          {ctx.alder, @friday, "HH Nights 3rd Call"},
+          {ctx.hazel, @friday, "SMH Obstetrics Resident 2nd Contact Night"}
+        ] do
+      add_activity(ctx, resident, date, task)
+    end
+
+    assert spans(ctx.alder) == [{"ambulatory", ~D[2026-10-05], ~D[2026-10-11]}]
+    assert spans(ctx.cedar) == [{"night_float", ~D[2026-10-05], ~D[2026-10-11]}]
+  end
+
+  test "explicit same-day night duty and approved coverage take precedence over the usual-team correction",
+       ctx do
+    add_activity(ctx, ctx.alder, @friday, "SMH Obstetrics Resident 1st Contact Night")
+    add_activity(ctx, ctx.fern, @friday, "SMH Obstetrics Resident 4th Contact Night")
+    [rotation] = Rotations.list_rotations_for_resident(ctx.cedar.id)
+
+    {:ok, _} =
+      ShiftOverrides.create_override(%{
+        rotation_id: rotation.id,
+        covering_schedule_resident_id: ctx.hazel.id,
+        override_start_date: @friday,
+        override_end_date: @friday
+      })
+
+    assert day_type(ctx.fern, @friday) == "night_float"
+    assert day_type(ctx.dogwood, @friday) == "post_call"
+
+    cedar =
+      Enum.find(
+        Rotations.effective_segments_for_resident(ctx.cedar.id),
+        &(&1.start_date == @friday)
+      )
+
+    assert cedar.rotation_type == "night_float"
+    assert cedar.covered_by.id == ctx.hazel.id
+
+    assert Enum.any?(
+             Rotations.effective_segments_for_resident(ctx.hazel.id),
+             &(&1.is_coverage and &1.rotation_type == "night_float" and &1.start_date == @friday)
+           )
+  end
+
+  test "projection is scoped to schedule identity and removal of evidence restores the unsplit block",
+       ctx do
+    activity = add_activity(ctx, ctx.alder, @friday, "SMH Obstetrics Resident 1st Contact Night")
+    {:ok, other_schedule} = Schedules.upsert_schedule(2025, "2025–2026")
+
+    {:ok, other} =
+      Residents.insert_resident(other_schedule.id, %{
+        name: "Alder",
+        resident_id: ctx.alder.resident_id,
+        position_code: "R1-1",
+        residency_year: 1,
+        schedule_number: 1
+      })
+
+    # Deliberately overlapping dates exercise schedule identity independently of date matching.
+    insert_rotation(other, :night_float, ~D[2026-10-05], ~D[2026-10-11])
+    assert day_type(other, @friday) == "night_float"
+    assert day_type(ctx.alder, @friday) == "night_float"
+    Repo.delete!(activity)
+    assert spans(ctx.alder) == [{"ambulatory", ~D[2026-10-05], ~D[2026-10-11]}]
+    assert spans(ctx.cedar) == [{"night_float", ~D[2026-10-05], ~D[2026-10-11]}]
+  end
+
+  test "calendar and resident details use full schedule evidence even after resident filtering",
+       ctx do
+    add_activity(ctx, ctx.alder, @friday, "SMH Obstetrics Resident 1st Contact Night")
+    {:ok, calendar, _} = live(ctx.conn, "/calendar?view=day&date=2026-10-09")
+    assert has_element?(calendar, calendar_person("night_float", ctx.alder))
+    assert has_element?(calendar, calendar_person("post_call", ctx.cedar))
+    assert has_element?(calendar, calendar_person("ambulatory", ctx.birch))
+    render_click(calendar, "toggle_resident_filter", %{"id" => to_string(ctx.cedar.resident_id)})
+    assert has_element?(calendar, calendar_person("post_call", ctx.cedar))
+    refute has_element?(calendar, "#day-activities [data-resident-id='#{ctx.alder.resident_id}']")
+
+    {:ok, resident, _} = live(ctx.conn, "/residents/#{ctx.alder.id}")
+
+    selector =
+      "#rotation-table tr[data-rotation-type='night_float'][phx-value-start-date='2026-10-09'][phx-value-end-date='2026-10-09']"
+
+    assert has_element?(resident, selector, "SMH Obstetrics Resident 1st Contact Night")
+    resident |> form("#resident-activity-date-form", %{"date" => "2026-10-09"}) |> render_change()
+    refute has_element?(resident, "#resident-day-activities", "Base rotation: Ambulatory")
+
+    {:ok, usual, _} = live(ctx.conn, "/residents/#{ctx.cedar.id}")
+    usual |> form("#resident-activity-date-form", %{"date" => "2026-10-09"}) |> render_change()
+    assert has_element?(usual, "#resident-day-activities", "Post Call")
+    render_click(usual, "toggle_night_shifts", %{})
+    assert has_element?(usual, "div", ~r/Night Float – Strong\s+6 days/)
+
+    assert has_element?(
+             usual,
+             "#sticky-stats",
+             ~r/Total Shifts\s+6/
+           )
+  end

+defmodule ResidencyScheduleWeb.ObservabilityLiveViewTest do
+  use ResidencyScheduleWeb.ConnCase, async: false
+
+  import Phoenix.LiveViewTest
+
+  alias ResidencySchedule.Observability
+  alias ResidencyScheduleWeb.{CalendarLive, ScheduleLive}
+
+  @operations [:mount, :handle_params, :handle_event, :render]
+  @views [{CalendarLive.Index, "calendar"}, {ScheduleLive.Index, "schedule"}]
+  @buckets [1, 5, 10, 25, 50, 100, 250, 500, 1000, 5000]
+
+  setup :authenticate_session
+
+  test "OTLP histograms convert durations, preserve every series and exclude private metadata" do
+    start_exporter()
+    secret = "PRIVATE_RESIDENT_EVENT_URL_SESSION_SENTINEL"
+
+    for operation <- @operations, {view, _label} <- @views, milliseconds <- [12, 5500] do
+      metadata = %{
+        socket: %Phoenix.LiveView.Socket{view: view, assigns: %{resident: secret}},
+        event: secret,
+        params: %{secret => secret},
+        session: %{token: secret},
+        uri: "https://example.test/#{secret}?token=#{secret}"
+      }
+
+      emit_operation(operation, milliseconds, metadata)
+    end
+
+    # Unrelated views cannot create more series. Malformed metadata is checked
+    # directly against definitions, because Phoenix's own loggers require sockets.
+    for operation <- @operations do
+      metadata = %{
+        socket: %Phoenix.LiveView.Socket{view: ResidencyScheduleWeb.CompareLive.Index},
+        params: %{},
+        session: %{},
+        uri: nil,
+        event: "ignored"
+      }
+
+      emit_operation(operation, 777, metadata)
+    end
+
+    # Exercise all existing series in the same interval as the eight LiveView series.
+    conn = Plug.Test.conn("GET", "/") |> Map.put(:status, 200)
+
+    :telemetry.execute(
+      [:phoenix, :endpoint, :stop],
+      %{duration: native(12)},
+      %{conn: conn, options: [log: false]}

+# Run only against a disposable database created by the runner:
+# SCHEDULE_BENCHMARK_DATABASE=residency_schedule_cache_bench_<suffix> \
+#   MIX_ENV=test mix run --no-start test/support/benchmarks/schedule_cache.exs
+# Drop that database after completion, including after a failed run.
+database = System.fetch_env!("SCHEDULE_BENCHMARK_DATABASE")
+
+unless Regex.match?(~r/^residency_schedule_cache_bench_[a-z0-9_]+$/, database),
+  do: raise("benchmark requires an explicitly named disposable database")
+
+repo_options =
+  Application.fetch_env!(:residency_schedule, ResidencySchedule.Repo)
+  |> Keyword.put(:database, database)
+  |> Keyword.put(:pool, DBConnection.ConnectionPool)
+
+Application.put_env(:residency_schedule, ResidencySchedule.Repo, repo_options)
+Application.put_env(:residency_schedule, :current_date, ~D[2026-10-13])
+{:ok, _} = Application.ensure_all_started(:residency_schedule)
+Ecto.Migrator.run(ResidencySchedule.Repo, "priv/repo/migrations", :up, all: true)
+Logger.configure(level: :warning)
+Application.put_env(:residency_schedule, :chat, enabled: false)
+
+{:ok, _, _} =
+  File.read!("priv/demo/demo_schedule.csv")
+  |> ResidencySchedule.Importer.ScheduleImporter.import_csv()
+
+for year <- 2023..2025 do
+  csv =
+    Regex.replace(~r/202[67]/, File.read!("priv/demo/demo_schedule.csv"), fn digits ->
+      Integer.to_string(String.to_integer(digits) + year - 2026)
+    end)
+
+  {:ok, _, _} = ResidencySchedule.Importer.ScheduleImporter.import_csv(csv)
+end
+
+schedule = Enum.find(ResidencySchedule.Schedules.list_schedules(), &(&1.academic_year == 2026))
+
+batch =
+  ResidencySchedule.Repo.insert!(%ResidencySchedule.DetailedSchedules.ImportBatch{
+    schedule_id: schedule.id,
+    fingerprint: "synthetic-performance-probe",
+    header_start: ~D[2026-07-01],
+    header_end: ~D[2027-06-30]
+  })
+
+now = DateTime.utc_now() |> DateTime.truncate(:second)
+residents = ResidencySchedule.Residents.list_residents_across_schedules([schedule.id])
+
+activities =
+  for sr <- residents,
+      date <- Date.range(~D[2026-07-01], ~D[2027-06-30]),
+      do: %{
+        schedule_resident_id: sr.id,
+        date: date,
+        raw_task: "Synthetic Clinic",
+        inserted_at: now,
+        updated_at: now
+      }
+
+activity_rows =
+  activities
+  |> Enum.chunk_every(3000)
+  |> Enum.flat_map(fn chunk ->
+    {_, rows} =
+      ResidencySchedule.Repo.insert_all(ResidencySchedule.DetailedSchedules.Activity, chunk,
+        returning: [:id]
+      )
+
+    rows
+  end)
+
+activity_rows
+|> Enum.map(fn row ->
+  %{
+    activity_id: row.id,
+    batch_id: batch.id,
+    source_sheet: "Synthetic",
+    source_cell: "A#{row.id}",
+    raw_staff: "Synthetic Person",
+    display_name: "Synthetic Person",
+    previous_name: "Synthetic Person",
+    notes: [],
+    inserted_at: now,
+    updated_at: now
+  }
+end)
+|> Enum.chunk_every(3000)
+|> Enum.each(
+  &ResidencySchedule.Repo.insert_all(ResidencySchedule.DetailedSchedules.ActivitySource, &1)
+)
+
+IO.puts(Jason.encode!(%{synthetic_activities: length(activity_rows)}))
+
+defmodule LatencyProbe do
+  def event(_, measures, _, _) do
+    :ets.update_counter(:latency_probe_queries, :count, {2, 1}, {:count, 0})
+
+    for key <- [:total_time, :query_time, :decode_time, :queue_time] do
+      :ets.update_counter(:latency_probe_queries, key, {2, measures[key] || 0}, {key, 0})
+    end
+  end
+
+  def measure(label, fun) do
+    :ets.delete_all_objects(:latency_probe_queries)
+    {us, result} = :timer.tc(fun)
+
+    queries =
+      :ets.tab2list(:latency_probe_queries)
+      |> Map.new(fn {k, v} ->
+        {k, if(k == :count, do: v, else: v / System.convert_time_unit(1, :millisecond, :native))}
+      end)
+
+    IO.puts(Jason.encode!(%{phase: label, wall_ms: us / 1000, db: queries}))
+    result
+  end
+end
+
+:ets.new(:latency_probe_queries, [:named_table, :public, :set, write_concurrency: true])
+
+:telemetry.attach(
+  :latency_probe,
+  [:residency_schedule, :repo, :query],
+  &LatencyProbe.event/4,
+  nil
+)
+
+schedules = ResidencySchedule.Schedules.list_schedules()
+
+IO.puts(
+  Jason.encode!(%{
+    fixture: "four academic years plus detailed current-year daily assignments",
+    schedules: length(schedules),
+    residents:
+      ResidencySchedule.Repo.aggregate(ResidencySchedule.Residents.ScheduleResident, :count),
+    rotations: ResidencySchedule.Repo.aggregate(ResidencySchedule.Rotations.Rotation, :count)
+  })
+)
+
+try do
+  # Explicit transactions bypass the shared cache. Compare identical database
+  # rows; timestamps and generated identities differ across independent seeds.
+  {:ok, reference} =
+    ResidencySchedule.Repo.transaction(fn ->
+      socket = %Phoenix.LiveView.Socket{
+        assigns: %{
+          __changed__: %{},
+          current_user: %ResidencySchedule.Accounts.User{role: :resident, tour_completed: true}
+        }
+      }
+
+      {:ok, mounted} = ResidencyScheduleWeb.ScheduleLive.Index.mount(%{}, %{}, socket)
+
+      html =
+        ResidencyScheduleWeb.ScheduleLive.Index.render(mounted.assigns)
+        |> Phoenix.HTML.Safe.to_iodata()
+        |> IO.iodata_to_binary()
+
+      {{mounted.assigns.all_slots, mounted.assigns.unified_residents}, html}
+    end)
+
+  outputs =
+    for run <- 1..5 do
+      socket = %Phoenix.LiveView.Socket{
+        assigns: %{
+          __changed__: %{},
+          current_user: %ResidencySchedule.Accounts.User{role: :resident, tour_completed: true}
+        }
+      }
+
+      {:ok, mounted} =
+        LatencyProbe.measure("schedule.mount.#{run}", fn ->
+          ResidencyScheduleWeb.ScheduleLive.Index.mount(%{}, %{}, socket)
+        end)
+
+      html =
+        LatencyProbe.measure("schedule.render_html.#{run}", fn ->
+          ResidencyScheduleWeb.ScheduleLive.Index.render(mounted.assigns)
+          |> Phoenix.HTML.Safe.to_iodata()
+          |> IO.iodata_to_binary()
+        end)
+
+      grid = {mounted.assigns.all_slots, mounted.assigns.unified_residents}
+
+      IO.puts(
+        Jason.encode!(%{
+          run: run,
+          slot_count: length(mounted.assigns.all_slots),
+          row_count: length(mounted.assigns.unified_residents),
+          cell_count: Enum.sum(Enum.map(mounted.assigns.unified_residents, &length(&1.cells))),
+          html_bytes: byte_size(html),
+          grid_sha256: Base.encode16(:crypto.hash(:sha256, :erlang.term_to_binary(grid))),
+          html_sha256: Base.encode16(:crypto.hash(:sha256, html))
+        })
+      )
+
+      {grid, html}
+    end
+
